name: Maximize Script (Metascript)
body:
Your scripts have the maximum possible effect.

Prerequisite: Caster level 7th

Benefit: All variable, numeric effects of a script modified by this feat are maximized. Saving throws and opposed rolls are not affected, nor are scripts without random variables.

You can maximize a script once per day, plus an additional time each day at 14th level. The script must be at least two levels lower than the highest level of script you can cast.
